lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher density of smaller, less-ordered spots appearing immediately posterior to the branchial region and superior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, aligning with the centers of the large circular blobs to create a grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a lighter dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral border.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple secondary biological signatures (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column and near the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
